title: Kumzari language
description: Southwestern Iranian language of Oman and United Arab Emirates
extract: Kumzari is a Southwestern Iranian language that has similarities with Persian, Luri, Achomi and Balochi languages. Although vulnerable, it survives today with between 4,000 and 5,000 speakers. It is spoken by Kumzaris, part of the Shihuh, on the Kumzar coast of Musandam Peninsula. Kumzari speakers are also found in the towns of Dibba and Khasab as well as various villages and on Larak Island in Iran.
